title: Ondansetron Rate on Observation and Emergency Accounts — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
| Payer class | Ondansetron (code J2405 under revenue code 0636) rate per counted unit |
|---|---|
| Commercial HMO Claim | 1.65 USD |
| Commercial PPO Claim | 1.90 USD |
| otherwise (a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim) | its charges per counted unit times the payer class's expected allowed percentage |

The schedule applies to ondansetron on an Observation Stay Account or Emergency Department Visit Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing). Ondansetron is valued at its counted units times that rate, never above its charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

Hypothetical: 5 units on a Commercial PPO Claim, charges 40.00 → 9.50; the same 5 units charged 6.00 → 6.00.
